description: Ghana Air Force armed trainer on a concrete pad on the fort lawn beside the Mi-2. The serial G 707 was read directly off the rear fuselage in a dated photograph of 7 September 2013 (jbdodane on Wikimedia Commons); the aircraft is still on the same pad in current Google satellite imagery. Wears a two-tone sand and grey camouflage with the Ghana flag on the fin and Ghana roundels. Variant F follows aviationmuseum.eu and Ghana's known MB.326F order and is not independently confirmed.

Small twin-turbine helicopter standing on the grass immediately behind the MB-326 at the fort entrance. Type identified from the same dated 2013 photograph: glazed nose, twin intakes above the cabin and a three-blade main rotor. Wikimedia Commons has this airframe miscategorised as an SA 330 Puma, which the photograph refutes. aviationmuseum.eu reports the serial as G-661 but no serial is legible in any photograph seen, so tail_number is left blank. Green camouflage with Ghana roundel.
